sources: Full text: PMC11290756 (Gut Microbes 16:2382324), Methods, '16s rRNA gene sequencing'

amplicon.paper_statement: PCR amplicons targeting the V3-V4 region; 16S Amplicon PCR Forward Primer = 5'CCTACGGGNGGCWGCAG, Reverse Primer = 5'GACTACHVGGGTATCTAATCC, attached to Illumina overhang adaptors; Illumina MiSeq 2 x 300 bp paired-end; 'Demultiplexed and adaptor-trimmed reads' were used.
amplicon.primer_evidence: The overhang ADAPTORS were trimmed by the submitters, but the locus-specific primers were not: with IUPAC expansion and <=2 mismatches the forward primer matches 99% of R1 and the reverse 97% of R2 (probe over 3 runs x 3000 reads).

insert_length_primer_free.method: measured, not assumed: R1 was slid against revcomp(R2) over 2430 read pairs from 5 runs and the aligning offset taken as that molecule's insert length (>=80% identity in the overlap)
insert_length_primer_free.note: The often-quoted '~465 bp' for 341F/805R is the E. coli amplicon INCLUDING both primers. The real primer-free inserts here are 402-428 bp and clearly multi-modal across taxa, so a single fixed length must not be used.

amplicon.trunc_len_basis: RAW read coordinates. dada2::filterAndTrim truncates to truncLen FIRST and removes trimLeft afterwards, so the retained biological sequence is truncLen - trimLeft. Every merge constraint below is stated in the same raw-read units.

merge_budget.formula: truncLen[1] + truncLen[2] >= insert_p99 + min_overlap + trimLeft[1] + trimLeft[2] = 427 + 12 + 38

amplicon.read_through: none: only 2 of 20228 R1 reads ran into revcomp(805R), so no 3' adaptor read-through to trim; truncLen is limited by quality alone.
amplicon.max_trunc_len_reason: read length; no 3' read-through to avoid

sample_identity.technical_controls_in_run_set: none detected: ENA isolation_source is 'stool' for all 110 and no buffer/blank/mock aliases are present

decodable_from_alias.sample_type: the _Colon / _Cecum suffix marks terminal tissue-site samples; the rest are stool
decodable_from_alias.sex: the M / F letter in prefixes such as BPCM3 / BPCF3

group_assignment.reason: The alias prefixes (BPC, CRN, EI, EBP, EIBP, G1-G5, D1-D4) are not defined anywhere in the paper, its figures or its supplementary material. Expanding them would be a guess.
group_assignment.action: experimental_group stays 'unresolved' in sample_metadata.csv. ASV and relative-abundance tables can still be built; any case/control use of this paper is blocked until the author's key is obtained.

usable_for: within-paper comparisons by timepoint and by sample type (stool / colon / cecum)
not_usable_for: any treatment-group contrast: the alias prefixes are undefined in the paper

experiment.design: germ-free and human-microbiota-associated mice; SC-4 consortium of 4 rare SCFA-producing bacteria +/- inulin; DSS-induced colitis; longitudinal sampling
